body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> The nPower® PEG is a universal backup charger for hand-held electronic devices. It's the next generation of hybrid chargers, receiving a charge from the kinetic energy you generate while walking, running, or biking, AND via USB. To capture & store your kinetic energy, just place your nPower® PEG in a backpack, briefcase, or purse and go. As you move, your PEG will continuously top-off its internal battery providing you with extra power when you need it most. –When you're on the go.

You depend on your phone, Mp3 player, GPS, and other hand-held electronic while you're on the go. With the nPower® PEG, you can extend your device's use time when you do not have access to a wall outlet. Just plug your device into your nPower® PEG and press the "charge" button. –You'll have an extra boost of power to call home, send an email, or listen to music. And, if you're in an emergency situation, shaking your nPower® PEG will give you the ability to call for help or get in touch with a loved one.
